# One Load of Steel

<!-- STEP id="pile" -->
Steel has many uses. The same steel can make medical equipment, aircraft or refrigerators.

<!-- STEP id="competing" -->
The steel can be shared out, but each bar used for one job cannot be used for another. More steel for aircraft means less for medical equipment or refrigerators.

**Resources have other uses, so using them one way means giving up another.**
